rca_invalid_journey.bug: TASK 2E: Invalid journey ID shows empty content instead of redirecting to /dashboard
rca_invalid_journey.root_cause: StudioJourneyView (JourneyCanonicalRoutes.jsx line 76-81) renders JourneyOperatingPage for all non-legacy requests. JourneyOperatingPage (line 148-170) calls /api/journeys/:jid/overview, and on 404 catch, only sets setLoading(false) but does NOT navigate to /dashboard. The redirect logic exists ONLY in the legacy fallback path (line 83-84). Solution: Add useNavigate in JourneyOperatingPage and in the .catch() handler, if error.response.status === 404, call navigate('/dashboard', { replace: true })
rca_invalid_journey.fix: In the catch block (line 170), add: if (e?.response?.status === 404) { navigate('/dashboard', { replace: true }); return; }. Import useNavigate from react-router-dom.
